title: Pass the current time into domain rules

facts.note: Role (PLT-84), mapped to paths by the structure profile.
The task has rules that depend on the current time.
Diff reads the system clock inside a domain-role module.

fires: A domain rule decides whether something has expired.
A domain function reads the system clock.
doesNotFire: Timestamps recorded by an integration adapter.

given: A domain rule depends on the current time
when: the agent writes or edits that rule
then: Take the current time as an explicit input; read the clock only in an outer role and pass the value in.
prefer: Read the clock once per request through an injectable clock owned by the composition root, and use the same instant for every decision in that request.
Tests pass fixed instants on both sides of each boundary (just before, at, just after).
avoid: Reading the system clock inside domain logic.
Reading the clock several times in one decision.
why: Hidden clock reads make time rules untestable at their boundaries and inconsistent within one request.
evidence: No domain-role module reads the system clock.
